test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

Though they allow celebrities and famous people to take pictures **(inside the museum, but they does not allow the general public)** to do the same.

options.text: inside the museum, they do not allow the general public
inside the museum, but do not allowing the general public
inside the museum, they does not allow general public

solution:
The correct answer is **"inside the museum, they do not allow the general public."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part** "does not allow"** of the sentence.
 
• Using **"does not"** would be grammatically incorrect in this context because **"does"** is the singular form of the verb, and it doesn't agree with the plural subject **"they."**
 
• The reason to use** "do not"** instead of **"does not"** in the blank is to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• In this sentence, the subject is **"they,"** which is a plural pronoun.
 
• "**but**" will not be needed with **"thought"** hence** "but"** will be removed.
 
• When the subject is plural, the corresponding verb should also be in the plural form.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Though they allow celebrities and famous people to take pictures **inside the museum**__**, **__**they do not allow the general public**__ to do the same.*
